prompt: Create an original slow JRPG main theme for Lit: bittersweet and memorable, evoking a journey beneath glittering stars. Center it on one singable 8-bar leitmotif, first played by delicate solo harp, then passed to expressive violin, oboe and warm strings. Use a gentle 6/8 flow, no percussion, harp arpeggios, lyrical counterpoint, soft woodwinds, chamber strings and restrained French horn for warmth. Write late-Romantic harmony with suspensions, aching resolutions, modal color, subtle major/minor shifts and one graceful modulation. Convey nostalgia, wonder and tenderness—not grief: tears born from beauty, memory and fragile hope. Let the arrangement breathe through intimate pauses and natural dynamics. Build only to a moderate luminous swell, never epic or bombastic. Return to harp and solo violin, ending unresolved but peaceful, like a flame surviving through centuries. Optional distant wordless choir as texture only. No lyrics, drums, trailer hits, rhythmic ostinatos, electronics or heroic climax.
